text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval for the installation of on-street accessible parking spaces on both sides of Whitmore Avenue, east of Jimmy Wisdom Way. The accessible parking spaces will alternate from one side of the street to the other with the existing alternate side parking.

North York Community Council: 1. Designated an accessible parking space to operate from the 16th day of each month to the last day of each month, April 1st to November 30th on the north side of Whitmore Avenue, between a point 40.5 metres east of Jimmy Wisdom Way and a point 5.5 metres further east. 2. Designated an accessible parking space to operate from the 1st day of each month to the 15th day of each month, April 1st to November 30th and December 1st to March 31st on the south side of Whitmore Avenue, between a point 47.5 metres east of Jimmy Wisdom Way and a point 5.5 metres further east.
